subject.title: [Bug]: Agent heartbeat routes to wrong agent's session instead of its own

question: Should maintainers require live WSL2/Docker proof of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102307 for the global-scope secondary-agent heartbeat case before closing this issue?
rationale: Source inspection strongly supports the proposed identity-channel fix, but the issue is already flagged for live reproduction and the user saw environment-dependent symptoms around global session scope and dmScope.

options.title: Review PR 102307 with live proof
options.body: Require focused live proof for a secondary-agent heartbeat under session.scope global, then close this issue after the fix lands.

options.title: Accept source and unit proof
options.body: If maintainers judge the fallback-chain evidence sufficient, review and merge the narrow PR after unit coverage without additional live reproduction.

options.title: Defer to broader routing review
options.body: Keep this issue open and pause the PR if maintainers believe global session scope and dmScope need a broader compatibility decision first.

recommendation.title: Review PR 102307 with live proof
recommendation.body: Require focused live proof for a secondary-agent heartbeat under session.scope global, then close this issue after the fix lands.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent heartbeat-runner and agent-scope history makes this the strongest routing/proof decision owner from the available evidence.
